title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart – Media Use by Age Group
prompt: The bar chart below shows the percentage of adults in four age groups who used different media sources as their main source of news in a simulated country in 2023. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读图表标题、横轴与纵轴单位，再概括主要特征并进行比较。写作时不要加入个人观点或原因分析，只需客观描述数据。建议用20分钟完成，写至少150词。
